bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to statutory construction; establishing a biological definition of male and female; defining terms; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, by adding subdivisions.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 7.

Boy.

"Boy" means a minor human male.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 8.

Father.

"Father" means a male parent.

Sec. 3.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 9.

Female.

"Female" means, when used to refer to an individual, an individual who naturally has, had, will have, or would have, but for a developmental or genetic anomaly or historical accident, the reproductive system that at some point produces, transports, and utilizes eggs for fertilization.

Sec. 4.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 10.

Gender.

"Gender" has the meaning given to sex in subdivision 15, when used alone to refer to males, females, or the natural differences between males and females. Gender is not considered a synonym or shorthand expression for gender identity, experienced gender, gender expression, or gender role. This definition does not apply when the term is used in conjunction with other words or as an adjective to modify other words, or when context or explicit definition in existing state law, administrative rules, or guidelines of a governmental entity indicates otherwise. Gender is not synonymous with gender identity.

Sec. 5.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 11.

Girl.

"Girl" means a minor human female.

Sec. 6.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 12.

Male.

"Male" means, when used to refer to an individual, an individual who naturally has, had, will have, or would have, but for a developmental or genetic anomaly or historical accident, the reproductive system that at some point produces, transports, and utilizes sperm for fertilization.

Sec. 7.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 13.

Man.

"Man" means an adult human male, except when used as a generic reference to human beings.

Sec. 8.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 14.

Mother.

"Mother" means a female parent.

Sec. 9.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 15.

Sex.

"Sex" means, when referring to a characteristic of an individual, the individual's biological sex, either male or female. Sex is not synonymous with gender identity.

Sec. 10.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 645.451, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 16.

Woman.

"Woman" means an adult human female.
